meta.name: compose-creator-layer
meta.description: Composite a generated creator track into a product layer, per beat — in the creator's zone on split beats (either side of a seam), full frame on creator beats, hidden on product beats — with the creator's voice as the audio (loudness -14 LUFS) and an optional ducked music bed, or a music-only or silent master for voiceless formats. Free, local ffmpeg. Pairs with footage-cutlist (the layer) and create-creator-takes-h3 (the creator). Use for split-screen, screen-insert and any creator-over-product format.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把创作者画面按节拍合成进产品视频,自动做分屏与全屏,输出带配音或配乐的成片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要做创作者出镜或分屏形式的产品视频并想在本地直接合成
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you make creator-over-product videos and want to composite them locally

howto.what: 按节拍把创作者画面合成进产品画面：分屏节拍放进指定区域（接缝左侧或右侧），创作者节拍全屏，产品节拍隐藏。音频默认用创作者人声（-14 LUFS），可加被压低的音乐垫，也能输出纯音乐或静音母版。全部用本地 ffmpeg 处理，免费。
howto.when: 当你做分屏、屏幕插入或其他创作者叠在产品画面上的格式时触发。它接在 footage-cutlist 输出的画面层和 create-creator-takes-h3 的创作者片段之后使用。

say.text: 把 creator.mp4 按节拍合成到产品画面，输出 reel.mp4
say.note: 分屏/全屏/隐藏按节拍切换

say.text: 改用音乐垫，音量 -20dB，输出纯音乐母版
say.note: 无口播的付费广告格式

say.text: 加音乐垫并在人声下压低，响度保持 -14 LUFS
say.note: 人声优先，音乐被侧链压低

howto.what_en: Per beat, composites a creator track into a product layer: creator zone on split beats, full frame on creator beats, hidden on product beats. Voice audio (-14 LUFS) with optional ducked music bed, or music-only/silent. Free local ffmpeg.
howto.when_en: Use for split-screen, screen-insert and any creator-over-product format. Runs after footage-cutlist's layer and create-creator-takes-h3's creator track.

say_en.text: Composite creator.mp4 onto the product layer on cutlist beats, output reel.mp4
Use the music bed at -20 dB and output a music-only master
Add a music bed ducked under the voice, keep loudness at -14 LUFS
